note: Recorded by hand from https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directoryservice/latest/admin-guide/using-service-linked-roles.html before the parser was written. Counted the rows of the "Hybrid directory opt-in Region support" table under "Supported Regions for Directory Service service-linked roles": 27 rows, every one with "Yes" in the opt-in support column, so 27 covered and 0 excluded. The page says Directory Service uses the AWSServiceRoleForDirectoryService role only in Regions where you can opt in to hybrid directories, so this table is the Region list for the service-linked role. The sentence "does not support using service-linked roles in every Region where the service is available" is not an "all Regions except X" statement, so derivation stays enumerated, not universe-minus-exclusions. Region identity column codes resolve one-to-one via resolveRegion; none were left unresolved. Review note: the table proves hybrid directory opt-in support, and the role Region list is inferred from the "only in AWS Regions where you can opt-in to hybrid directories" sentence, which is an upper bound, so the feature is named for the role as it applies to hybrid directories and whatIsCounted names the opt-in table.

features.name: Directory Service service-linked role for hybrid directories
